chapterInfo.content:
8
Asɔrefie akyiwadeɛ ho anisoadehunu
1 # Hes 14.1 Na afe a ɛtɔ so nsia, bosome a ɛtɔ so nsia, da a ɛtɔ so nnum a mete me fie na Yuda mpanimfoɔ tete m’anim no, AWURADE Nyankopɔn nsa tɔɔ me so wɔ hɔ. 2Na mehwɛe, na hwɛ, onipa suban bi a ɛte sɛ ogya nie, ɛfiri deɛ ɛte sɛ n’asene mu de rekɔ fam yɛ ogya, na ɛfiri n’asene mu de rekɔ soro no te sɛ ɔhyerɛn, ɛte sɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ a adɔ ahoa ani. 3#Hes 3.12 Na ɔyii biribi a ɛte sɛ nsa nsɛsoɔ, na ɔsɔɔ m’atifi nwi mu, na honhom no maa me so faa asase ne ɔsoro ntam de me kɔɔ Yerusalem, Nyankopɔn anisoadehunu no mu, de me baa emu fam ponkɛseɛ a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam no ano, deɛ ninkuntwe honi bi a ɛyi ninkunu sie hɔ. 4#Hes 1.4-28 Na hwɛ, na Israel Nyankopɔn animuonyam wɔ hɔ sɛ adeɛ a mehunuu no bonhwa no mu no.
5Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, ma w’ani so kɔ atifi fam ɛ! Na memaa m’ani so kɔɔ atifi fam, na hwɛ, afɔrebukyia ponkɛseɛ no atifi fam na ninkuntwe honi no sie wɔ aboboano. 6Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, wohunu deɛ wɔreyɛ yi? Akyiwadeɛ akɛseɛ a Israel fie reyɛ wɔ ha yi, sɛ memfiri me kronkronbea menkɔ akyirikyiri. Na wobɛsane ahunu akyiwadeɛ akɛseɛ bio.
7Na ɔde me baa abannwa so pono ano, na mehwɛe, na hwɛ, na tokuro baako wɔ ɔfasuo no mu. 8Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, bɔne fasuo no mu tokuro ɛ! Na mebɔnee ɔfasuo no mu tokuro, na hwɛ, ɛpono bi nie. 9Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Hyɛne mu kɔhwɛ akyiwadeɛ bɔne a wɔreyɛ no wɔ ha. 10#Rom 1.23 Ɛnna mehyɛnee mu mekɔhwɛeɛ, na hwɛ, mmoa a wɔwea ne mmoa ahodoɔ a wɔkyire nyinaa ne Israel fie abosom ahoni nyinaa na wɔakurukyire wɔ wɔn ɔfasuo no ho ahyia yi. 11Na mmarima aduɔson a wɔfiri Israel fie mpanimfoɔ mu a Safan ba Yaasania gyina wɔn mu gyinagyina wɔn anim, na wɔn aduhwamhyeɛ kukuo kurakura wɔn nsam, na aduhwamhyeɛ wisie no hwa sɔree. 12#Hes 9.9; Dwom 94.7 Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, wohunu deɛ Israel fie mpanimfoɔ reyɛ no esum mu, wɔn ahoni mpia mu mmaako mmaako? Ɛfiri sɛ wɔka sɛ: AWURADE nhu yɛn, AWURADE agya asase no. 13Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Wobɛsane ahunu akyiwadeɛ akɛseɛ a wɔreyɛ bio.
14Ɛnna ɔde me baa AWURADE fie ponkɛseɛ a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam no ano, na hwɛ, ɛhɔ na na mmaa teteɛ resu Tamus.#8.14 TAMUS: Oyi ne onyame a na wɔgye di sɛ ɔtumi ma afuom aduane ba pii, a na wɔsom no wɔ Mesopotamia, Siria ne Palestina. Nnipa a na wɔsom no titire no yɛ mmaa. 15Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, woahunu? Wobɛsane ahunu akyiwadeɛ akɛseɛ a ɛsene yeinom bio.
16 # 2 Be 29.6 Ɛnna ɔde me baa AWURADE fie mu fam abannwa soɔ, na hwɛ, AWURADE asɔredan ano, ntwonoo ne afɔrebukyia no ntam no, mmarima aduonu nnum a wɔn akyiri kyerɛ AWURADE asɔredan na wɔn anim kyerɛ apueeɛ resɔre owia nie. 17Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, woahunu yei? Ɛyɛ hare ma Yuda fie sɛ wɔyɛ akyiwadeɛ a wɔyɛ no ɛha yi, sɛ wɔde atirimuɔden rehyɛ asase yi so ma, na wɔasane abɛhuru me boɔ? Na hwɛ, wɔde duban no ka wɔn hwene. 18#Yes 1.15 Na me nso, mɛdi no anibereɛ so; m’ani renni ho adɔna, na merenhunu mmɔbɔ; na wɔde nne kɛseɛ bɛsu agu m’aso mu deɛ, nanso merentie wɔn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
